# cloudflare_ct_alerting (Resource)

Accepted Permissions

- `SSL and Certificates Read`
- `SSL and Certificates Write`

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cloudflare_ct_alerting" "example_ct_alerting" {
  zone_id = "023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353"
  enabled = true
  emails = ["security@example.com", "admin@example.com"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether CT alerting is enabled for the zone.
- `zone_id` (String) Identifier.

### Optional

- `emails` (List of String) Email addresses that receive CT alert notifications for the zone. A maximum of 100 addresses may be configured. Each address must be a valid RFC 5322 email address and must not contain a comma.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
$ terraform import cloudflare_ct_alerting.example '<zone_id>'
```
